findings.title: Fullness consumed into depletion
findings.claim: The dream compresses an ecological-economic reversal: fat cattle are consumed by lean cattle while green growth stands beside dry ears, so stored vitality is shown passing into depletion.
findings.mechanism: The supplied dream branch carries the scene, and the focus eating, green-growth, lean, and drying forms meet wider rows on nourishment failure, green emergence and future potential, a realized dream, and wet-dry contrast; the paired images therefore operate as a process rather than isolated objects.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees one moving relation: bodily fullness is consumed by visible weakness while living green is placed against moisture loss, so the dream's impossible scene carries a depletion process.
findings.containment: The literal cows and ears remain the recoverable scene; the wider parallels add an ecological-economic resonance without deciding that the dream has only one referent. The legacy reader-walk corroboration remains qualified as unbound.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run publication supplies exact focus anchors and accepted branch records, while the corroborating reader walk is legacy_unbound and the connection targets omit target-side morphology.

branch_activations.carrier: The focus form yaʾkuluhunna carries the ordinary act of eating the cows.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 88:7 connection presents food that fails to fatten or relieve hunger and explicitly sharpens the focus's depletion side.
branch_activations.activation: The focus eating act meets that wider failure-of-nourishment image, so the relation is heard as transfer that can leave available abundance depleted.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Eating is part of a resource-flow image in which the lean group consumes the fat group.
branch_activations.boundary: The literal dream consumption remains; this activation does not turn the verb into an unrestricted metaphor for every kind of loss.
